changelog:
Privacy tools for the site owner: Tools > Export Personal Data and Tools > Erase Personal Data include the plugin's contact requests, found by the email entered in the form. Erasure also removes undelivered requests and their pending retries; requests with only a phone number are deleted from the plugin panel.
Received requests lets the owner choose how long delivered requests are kept: 7, 30, 90, 180 or 365 days (default 30, as before). Undelivered requests stay until the owner resends or deletes them.
Settings > Privacy suggests a privacy policy text with the AI provider, the 24-hour server conversations, the hashed IP, the retention days and the undelivered requests.
The plugin panel warns when the daily cleanup has not run for more than 48 hours or is not scheduled, and Received requests shows the last cleanup time. The Data handling section explains how to set up a real cron job with your host.
